title: KR-Housing-LongRAG-Bench
description: A copyright-safe Korean long-context benchmark for evaluating long-context LLMs, RAG systems, and table/tool pipelines over real housing announcements, public tabular data, and housing statutes. The public release contains QA labels, evidence locators, deterministic predicates, answerability labels, split and provider/region metadata, and long-context-bundle references. It does not redistribute raw PDF/HWP/HWPX documents, bundle text, the model input prompts (which contain bundle text), reasoning traces, or API keys. v0.9.5 keeps the 1,997 QA, questions, splits, gold fixes, evaluation scope (1,876 evaluated items), verdicts and every reported number of v0.9.4, and adds the final answer text of every judged prediction (24,074 model answers in results/predictions_v0.9.5/, mirroring the verdict files; reasoning traces and the unreported qwen3.5 runs excluded; one source-text span of 200 or more characters and 6 unverified phone numbers masked). The model answers are not covered by CC BY 4.0, remain subject to each model provider's terms of use, are released for reproducing and re-judging the evaluation, and must not be used to train competing models. The release is not leaderboard-ready and has no sealed hidden split. v0.9.6 adds a pre-specified run: dense bge-m3 k=50 plus the whole announcement page as one passage on the 18 aggregation items whose k=50 passages lacked it (two announcement-table pairs); gpt-5.5, minimax-m3, glm-5.2 and claude-sonnet-5-5 rise from 0 to 15-18 of 18 (primary judge). Verdicts, model answers (not covered by CC BY 4.0) and scripts are released; the pre-specification document is in results/judge_verdicts_v0.9.6/PRESPECIFICATION.md.
